title: C10 loan-type variant
description: Catalog row c10-outputs 1.0.0: one Federal Reserve loan type of the portfolio credit capital case (outputs.kind loan-type), real charge-off rates and an illustrative portfolio.

c10Window.description: A window of calendar years; n_years = last_year - first_year + 1 (a producer check).

c10Windows.description: The fit window (SDD section 5: 1985-2006) and the out-of-sample evaluation window (2007-2012); the fit window ends before the evaluation window begins.

estimate.description: An asset correlation is open: 0 < rho < 1 (the Vasicek model has no value at 0 or 1).

ci_low.description: An asset correlation is open: 0 < rho < 1 (the Vasicek model has no value at 0 or 1).

ci_high.description: An asset correlation is open: 0 < rho < 1 (the Vasicek model has no value at 0 or 1).

c10Interval.description: An estimate with its interval, all inside (0, 1); ci_low <= estimate <= ci_high (a producer check).

estimate.description: An estimate-site PD is open: 0 < pd < 1.

ci_low.description: An estimate-site PD is open: 0 < pd < 1.

ci_high.description: An estimate-site PD is open: 0 < pd < 1.

c10PdInterval.description: A PD estimate with its interval, all inside the open interval (0, 1).

c10MissingQuarter.description: A quarter missing from the Federal Reserve table, with its reason; never interpolated.

c10DataStatus.description: Where the loss-rate series came from: the Federal Reserve charge-off release (dossier 08 B.4, row 23), the table, the series column and the quarters it lacks.

n_quarters.description: Quarters of the year present in the table.

anyOf.description: An observed annual loss rate as a decimal per year, open (0, 1): the implied factor needs it.

loss_rate.description: The mean of the four quarterly annualised net charge-off rates; null when a quarter is missing.

reason.description: Why the rate is null; null when it is present.

anyOf.description: A share or an observed rate in [0, 1].

fitted_cdf.description: The fitted Vasicek distribution function at the rate: where the year falls in the fit.

implied_factor.description: The systematic factor z at which the conditional PD equals the rate (dossier 04 C.4).

exceeds_99.description: True when the rate is above the fitted 99% quantile.

exceeds_999.description: True when the rate is above the fitted 99.9% quantile.

c10AnnualRate.description: One calendar year of the loss-rate series with its position in the fitted distribution. A year with all four quarters carries every number and no reason; a year with a missing quarter carries null numbers and the reason, never an interpolated rate.

loss_rate.description: An observed annual loss rate as a decimal per year, open (0, 1): the implied factor needs it.

fitted_cdf.description: A share or an observed rate in [0, 1].

c10MlFit.description: The maximum-likelihood fit of the Vasicek distribution to the yearly rates of the fit window (dossier 04 C.4; engine asrf_fit.fit_ml), intervals by the profile likelihood.

c10MomentsFit.description: The method-of-moments fit (engine asrf_fit.fit_moments), intervals by the parametric bootstrap.

c10Fit.description: The two fits of the yearly series; n_years_used counts the fit-window years with a rate.

items.description: An asset correlation is open: 0 < rho < 1 (the Vasicek model has no value at 0 or 1).

log_likelihood.description: The profile log-likelihood at each grid correlation (the PD maximised out).

items.description: An estimate-site PD is open: 0 < pd < 1.

pd_at_rho.description: The maximising PD at each grid correlation.

cutoff.description: max_log_likelihood minus the chi-square(1) quantile at `level`, halved.

c10Profile.description: The profile likelihood of the asset correlation (dossier 04 C.4; engine asrf_fit.profile_likelihood): the three arrays have one length.

items.description: An observed annual loss rate as a decimal per year, open (0, 1): the implied factor needs it.

pdf.description: The Vasicek (large homogeneous portfolio) density at x.

items.description: A share or an observed rate in [0, 1].

cdf.description: The distribution function at x, nondecreasing.

value.description: An observed annual loss rate as a decimal per year, open (0, 1): the implied factor needs it.

pd.description: An estimate-site PD is open: 0 < pd < 1.

rho.description: An asset correlation is open: 0 < rho < 1 (the Vasicek model has no value at 0 or 1).

c10FittedDistribution.description: The fitted (maximum-likelihood) Vasicek distribution of the yearly loss rate: its density and distribution function and its quantiles; pd and rho equal the maximum-likelihood estimates (a producer check).

fitted_quantile.description: An observed annual loss rate as a decimal per year, open (0, 1): the implied factor needs it.

p_value_upper.description: A share or an observed rate in [0, 1].

c10BacktestRow.description: Years of the evaluation window above one fitted quantile: expected = n_years (1 - level), observed, and the upper binomial tail probability P(X >= observed) with success probability 1 - level.

c10Backtest.description: The tail back-test of the evaluation window against the quantiles fitted on the fit window (dossier 05 G.5; engine validation.portfolio.tail_backtest).

pd.description: An estimate-site PD is open: 0 < pd < 1.

lgd.description: A share or an observed rate in [0, 1].

irb_correlation.description: An asset correlation is open: 0 < rho < 1 (the Vasicek model has no value at 0 or 1).

fitted_correlation.description: An asset correlation is open: 0 < rho < 1 (the Vasicek model has no value at 0 or 1).

k_irb.description: The IRB capital requirement per unit of EAD (engine regulatory.irb.capital_requirement).

ec_lhp_fitted.description: lgd * (LHP quantile at 99.9% with the fitted correlation - pd), per unit of EAD.

c10IrbReference.description: How the fitted correlation compares with the IRB correlation of the loan type's regulatory class (dossier 04 C.4): the capital per unit of EAD both ways. Retail classes carry no maturity adjustment.

ead_each.description: Money in the `currency` of the enclosing block.

pd.description: An estimate-site PD is open: 0 < pd < 1.

lgd.description: A share or an observed rate in [0, 1].

loading.description: The factor loading sqrt(rho) of the group's names on the systematic factor.

c10Group.description: A group of identical names of the illustrative portfolio (dossier 04 H.1: EAD, expected LGD, PD, loading, sector).

pd.description: An estimate-site PD is open: 0 < pd < 1.

rho.description: An asset correlation is open: 0 < rho < 1 (the Vasicek model has no value at 0 or 1).

c10Calibration.description: The single PD and correlation the C1 rungs use, taken from the maximum-likelihood fit.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

total_ead.description: Money in the `currency` of the enclosing block.

lgd_mean.description: A share or an observed rate in [0, 1].

lgd_gamma.description: gamma of V[LGD] = gamma E[LGD] (1 - E[LGD]) (Gordy and Lutkebohmert 2013, eq. 16).

c10Portfolio.description: The illustrative portfolio: constructed, never a bank's (labelled `illustrative` here and in the provenance). hhi = sum of squared exposure shares and effective_names = 1 / hhi (dossier 04 H.6).

c10Simulation.description: How a Monte Carlo rung was run: scenarios, seed, and the chunk bound on memory.

level.description: A confidence level as a decimal.

el.description: Money in the `currency` of the enclosing block.

var.description: Money in the `currency` of the enclosing block.

anyOf.description: Money in the `currency` of the enclosing block.

ec.description: Money in the `currency` of the enclosing block.

var_se.description: Monte Carlo standard error of the VaR; null for an analytic rung.

es_se.description: Monte Carlo standard error of the ES; null for an analytic rung.

c10Measure.description: EL, VaR, ES and EC at one level (dossier 04 H.1): EC = VaR - EL. VaR is not below EL and ES is not below VaR (a producer check, JSON Schema cannot compare fields). A rung that defines no ES (the granularity adjustment) has es null and the reason.

c10LossCurve.description: The loss distribution of a rung on a money grid; the three arrays have one length.

reason.description: Why the rung did not run; null when it ran.

c10Rung.description: One rung of the portfolio ladder (dossier 04 'Portfolio credit risk': C1 LHP, C2 Gaussian copula, C3 Student-t copula, C4 CreditRisk+, C5 granularity adjustment, C6 importance sampling) on the illustrative portfolio. A rung that did not run (importance sampling for the Student-t copula) is a not-evaluated row: evaluated false, its reason, no measure, no curve; never a number.

es.description: Money in the `currency` of the enclosing block.

c10GaRow.description: The granularity adjustment of n identical names of the portfolio's mix: ga_ratio times n is constant.

ga_money.description: Money in the `currency` of the enclosing block.

c10GaPortfolio.description: The adjustment for the illustrative portfolio: ga_add_on_share = ga_ratio * k_star, as a share of EAD, and in money.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

q.description: A confidence level as a decimal.

alpha_q.description: The q-quantile of the Gamma factor with shape xi and rate xi (mean 1, variance 1/xi).

c10Granularity.description: The granularity adjustment of Gordy and Lutkebohmert (2013) (dossier 04 H.5): delta = (alpha_q - 1)(xi + (1 - xi) / alpha_q) (eq. 15), 4.83 at xi 0.25 and q 0.999, the adjustment for the portfolio, and the adjustment against the number of names.

rc_var.description: Money in the `currency` of the enclosing block.

c10EulerAnchor.description: The closed-form one-factor VaR contributions of Emmer and Tasche (2005), the anchor of the sample contributions.

es_sum_tolerance.description: Relative tolerance of the sum of the ES contributions against es_total.

c10EulerLevel.description: The contributions at one level. The contributions of a level sum to its totals within the stated tolerances (a producer check); the anchor is null with its reason where no closed form exists.

c10Euler.description: The Euler contributions of one sample-based rung, by portfolio group, at both levels.

c10LoanTypeOutputs.description: C10 loan-type outputs (outputs.kind loan-type): one Federal Reserve loan type, the Vasicek fit to its yearly loss rates (fit 1985-2006), the 2007-2012 tail back-test, and the loss distributions of the illustrative portfolio by rung with the Euler contributions and the concentration measures. Loss rates are decimals per year; money carries its currency.
